devdoc.details: Security notes (for the red-team round):      - Funds are locked at task creation (msg.value), never pulled later.      - Checks-Effects-Interactions + a reentrancy lock on every ETH transfer.      - Status machine prevents double payment / double refund.      - Leader cannot cancel once work is submitted (no front-run refund).      - Leader cannot sit on a submission forever (claimAfterReview).      - Rejection only inside the review window, and it extends the deadline        so the teammate can resubmit.      - No receive()/fallback(): stray ETH is rejected; accounting never        relies on address(this).balance, so forced ETH changes nothing.      - Trust assumption: the leader judges quality and may keep rejecting.

params._reviewPeriod: e.g. 120 (2 min) for the demo, 3 days for real use

removeMember(address).details: Removing a member does not touch tasks already funded for them.

devdoc.title: TaskEscrow

approveAndPay(uint256).notice: Leader approves -> teammate is paid instantly.

cancelExpired(uint256).notice: Leader recovers funds only if nothing was submitted by the deadline.

claimAfterReview(uint256).notice: If the leader ignores a submission, the teammate gets paid anyway.

createTask(string,string,address,uint64).notice: Leader creates a task and locks the reward in the same tx.

rejectWork(uint256,string).notice: Leader sends work back. Only allowed inside the review window,         and the deadline is pushed out so the teammate can resubmit.

submitWork(uint256,string,bytes32).notice: Teammate puts proof of work on-chain.

userdoc.notice: A team leader escrows ETH per task. The assigned teammate submits         proof of work (IPFS CID / commit URL + content hash) on-chain and is         paid the moment the leader approves. If the leader never reviews,         the teammate can self-claim after the review period.
